overrides.reason: Only Injury was modeled; neither alternative's benefit was evaluated. That ranking cannot compare Scroll Box's early development with the elite relic.
Slice leads the distant single-target simulation; immediate multi-enemy coverage favors Dagger Spray, supported by stronger observational Act 1 outcomes.
Enchantments are unmodeled, not inferior. Defend replay permanently improves a starter without adding deck dilution.
Boss-only ranking does not evaluate the unavoidable elite. Healing supplies 21 immediate HP; upgrading can wait until the following campfire.
Combat upgrades to Accelerant, Malaise, Neutralize, and replay Defend offer longer-fight flexibility while reducing pressure to smith.
Wail’s modeled margin gain is comparable to Dash’s; its lower price preserves Golden Seal fuel and provides broad multihit protection.
Only o0 was simulated, incompletely. Guaranteed gold fuels Golden Seal; two powers and no pre-boss removal make Decay unattractive.
Prefer long-fight draw flexibility over redundant AoE despite Spray’s small modeled margin advantage.
